entities.summary: Beyle (Berta) Friedberg, best known by the pen names Isabella and Isabella Arkadevna Grinevskaya, was a Russian-Jewish novelist, poet, and dramatist. As a translator, she translated into Russian works from Polish, German, French, Italian, Armenian, and Georgian.
